title: The House Finally Has a Speaker

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·荣森，欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 即使是在我还在夜店里用黑胶唱片打碟的年代，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你每天晚上都要带着300件你最珍视的宝贝去工作，把DJ台变成了一个充满50年历史精美文物的流动快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼出品的《重构者》。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今日话题。

sentences.en: On behalf of the House Republican Conference, I rise today to nominate the gentleman from Louisiana, Mike Johnson, as Speaker of the People's House.
sentences.zh: 我谨代表众议院共和党会议，提名路易斯安那州议员迈克·约翰逊为人民议院议长。

sentences.en: After 21 days without a leader and after cycling through four different nominees, House Republicans have finally elected a Speaker to lead the chamber.
sentences.zh: 在经历了21天群龙无首、轮换了四位不同提名人之后，众议院共和党人终于选出了一位议长来领导众议院。

sentences.en: Therefore, the Honorable Mike Johnson of the state of Louisiana, having received a majority of the votes cast,
sentences.zh: 因此，路易斯安那州的尊敬的迈克·约翰逊先生，在获得了多数投票后，

sentences.en: is duly elected Speaker of the House of Representatives for the 118th Congress.
sentences.zh: 正式当选为第118届国会众议院议长。

sentences.en: My colleague, congressional reporter Luke Broadwater, was inside the Capitol as it happened.
sentences.zh: 我的同事、国会记者卢克·布罗德沃特当时就在国会大厦内见证了这一时刻。

sentences.en: The committee will retire from the chamber to escort the Speaker-elect to the chair.
sentences.zh: 委员会将退席，护送候任议长就座。

sentences.en: Thursday, October 26th.
sentences.zh: 10月26日，星期四。

sentences.en: So Luke, it's 2.32 p.m.
sentences.zh: 那么卢克，现在是下午2点32分，

sentences.en: and you just raced into a phone booth inside the Capitol to talk to us, which is very nice of you.
sentences.zh: 你刚才冲进国会大厦里的电话亭来和我们通话，真是太感谢你了。

sentences.en: Because it entailed tearing yourself away from a historic scene that was unfolding.
sentences.zh: 因为这意味着你不得不从正在上演的历史性现场抽身出来。

sentences.en: And I want you to describe that scene.
sentences.zh: 我想请你描述一下那个场景。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: I was in the Speaker's lobby watching Republicans elect a new Speaker of the House, Mike Johnson of Louisiana.
sentences.zh: 我当时在议长休息室，看着共和党人选举出了一位新议长，即路易斯安那州的迈克·约翰逊。

sentences.en: He had just won.
sentences.zh: 他刚刚胜出。

sentences.en: They were lining up all the dignitaries in leadership to honor this new Speaker.
sentences.zh: 他们正在安排所有领导层政要列队，以向这位新议长致敬。

sentences.en: And there was a bit of a debate going on about who would present him the gavel.
sentences.zh: 当时关于由谁来向他颁发木槌还进行了一番讨论。

sentences.en: Would it be the former Speaker, the temporary Speaker, or the leader of the House Democrats?
sentences.zh: 是由前议长、临时议长，还是众议院民主党领袖来颁发呢？

sentences.en: And this was a monumental occasion because for more than three weeks now, the House has been paralyzed.
sentences.zh: 这是一个具有里程碑意义的时刻，因为在过去三个多星期里，众议院一直处于瘫痪状态。

sentences.en: No legislation has been able to move.
sentences.zh: 没有任何立法能够推进。

sentences.en: No aid for any of our allies overseas has been able to be approved.
sentences.zh: 没有任何对海外盟友的援助能够获得批准。

sentences.en: And a government shutdown is looming.
sentences.zh: 而且政府停摆的阴云笼罩。

sentences.en: And Republicans had been fighting amongst themselves bitterly through candidate after candidate.
sentences.zh: 共和党人在候选人之间陷入了激烈的内斗。

sentences.en: Unsuccessfully until they landed on Mike Johnson, who received a unanimous vote of his fellow House Republicans and now has the mandate to get the Congress back to work.
sentences.zh: 直到他们选中了迈克·约翰逊，他获得了众议院共和党同僚的一致投票，现在他有了让国会恢复工作的授权。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I think the key word there is unanimous, which seems pretty improbable given the battle we've just been through.
sentences.zh: 我认为其中的关键词是“一致”，考虑到我们刚刚经历的这场恶战，这似乎相当不可思议。

sentences.en: And I want to kind of set the stage for this conversation because the last time we covered this seemingly endless soap opera, Representative Jim Jordan was the nominee.
sentences.zh: 我想为这次谈话铺垫一下背景，因为我们上次报道这场看似没完没了的肥皂剧时，众议员吉姆·乔丹还是提名人。

sentences.en: And it looked like Jordan was going to be the next Speaker, despite his reputation for being very far to the right, an obstructionist, in the words of a former Speaker,
sentences.zh: 当时看起来乔丹要成为下一任议长了，尽管他以极右翼立场著称，用前议长约翰·博纳的话说，

sentences.en: John Boehner, a legislative terroriSt.
sentences.zh: 他是个“立法恐怖分子”。

sentences.en: So pick up the story from there and help us understand how we get to this moment.
sentences.zh: 那么请从那里接着讲，帮我们理解我们是如何走到这一步的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Jim Jordan was in the fight of his life to try to become the next House Speaker.
sentences.zh: 吉姆·乔丹当时正在为成为下一任众议院议长进行着他人生中最艰难的战斗。

sentences.en: And he had unleashed a pressure campaign against the holdouts from the more mainstream wing of the party that were refusing to vote for him.
sentences.zh: 他针对党内更主流派系中拒绝投票给他的反对者发动了一场施压运动。

sentences.en: On Capitol Hill now, some Republicans who voted against GOP Congressman Jim Jordan to be the next Speaker of the House say they're getting death threats.
sentences.zh: 在国会山，一些投票反对共和党众议员吉姆·乔丹担任下一任众议院议长的共和党人表示，他们收到了死亡威胁。

sentences.en: Threats and intimidation started to come in.
sentences.zh: 威胁和恐吓接踵而至。

sentences.en: Including Iowa's Marionette Miller-Meeks.
sentences.zh: 其中包括爱荷华州的玛丽安内特·米勒-米克斯。
zh_words: 玛丽安内特·米勒-米克斯

sentences.en: She said she's getting credible death threats and a barrage of threatening calls, but will not.
sentences.zh: 她说她收到了可信的死亡威胁和一连串的恐吓电话，但她不会屈服。

sentences.en: People started getting the personal cell phone numbers of members of Congress and their families.
sentences.zh: 人们开始获取国会议员及其家人的个人手机号码。

sentences.en: At one point, a congressman said that his wife had begun to sleep with a gun at night because of the threats against the family.
sentences.zh: 有一次，一位国会议员说，由于针对家人的威胁，他的妻子晚上开始带着枪睡觉。

sentences.en: And it was just getting uglier and uglier.
sentences.zh: 情况变得越来越恶劣。

sentences.en: And it actually had the reverse effect.
sentences.zh: 而且这实际上产生了反效果。

sentences.en: Instead of the moderates buckling under the pressure campaign, they dug in deeper to find the resolve and to fight back against these tactics.
sentences.zh: 温和派并没有在施压运动下屈服，反而更加坚定地寻找决心，反击这些手段。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The idea had been that Jordan was going to activate this far-right network, the party's base,
sentences.zh: 原本的想法是乔丹将激活这个极右翼网络，即党的基层，

sentences.en: to hound these moderate lawmakers and make them feel like they didn't really have a choice.
sentences.zh: 去骚扰这些温和派议员，让他们觉得他们别无选择。

sentences.en: They had to vote for Jordan or perhaps they'd lose re-election, but it turned out they did have a choice.
sentences.zh: 他们必须投票给乔丹，否则可能会输掉连任，但事实证明他们确实有选择。

sentences.en: And that choice was to create this unmovable block of moderate Republicans who basically said to Jim Jordan, your tactics are beyond the pale.
sentences.zh: 而那个选择就是建立一个不可动摇的温和派共和党集团，他们基本上对吉姆·乔丹说，你的手段太过分了。

sentences.en: This is not acceptable.
sentences.zh: 这是不可接受的。

sentences.en: You will not be our speaker.
sentences.zh: 你不会成为我们的议长。

sentences.en: And because Republicans have such a tight majority, it didn't take that many moderates to block him.
sentences.zh: 而且由于共和党在众议院的多数优势非常微弱，并不需要多少温和派就能阻止他。

sentences.en: Now, I will say Jim Jordan says he had nothing to do with the pressure campaign, that he can't control outside groups that were lobbying for him.
sentences.zh: 现在，我要说的是，吉姆·乔丹声称他与这场施压运动无关，他无法控制那些为他游说的外部团体。

sentences.en: But that said, his supporters really offended many members of Congress.
sentences.zh: 但话虽如此，他的支持者确实冒犯了许多国会议员。

sentences.en: And because of the slim margins in Congress, any Republican speaker candidate can only afford to lose four fellow Republican votes,
sentences.zh: 由于国会中微弱的优势，任何共和党议长候选人最多只能承受四张共和党同僚的反对票，

sentences.en: provided all the Democrats vote against the Republican, which is, you know, the way the chamber operates.
sentences.zh: 前提是所有民主党人都投票反对共和党，你知道，这就是众议院的运作方式。

sentences.en: The next order of business is the election of speakers of the House of Representatives for the 118th Congress.
sentences.zh: 下一项议程是选举第118届国会众议院议长。

sentences.en: Nominations are now in order.
sentences.zh: 现在开始提名。

sentences.en: And Jim Jordan ended up losing 25 fellow Republican votes.
sentences.zh: 最终吉姆·乔丹失去了25张共和党同僚的选票。

sentences.en: I rise today to nominate the gentleman from Ohio, Jim Jordan, as speaker of the People's House.
sentences.zh: 我谨提名俄亥俄州议员吉姆·乔丹为人民议院议长。

sentences.en: And he lost them over a course of three different floor votes.
sentences.zh: 而且他在三轮不同的全院投票中失去了这些选票。

sentences.en: And each time the opposition to Jim Jordan grew.
sentences.zh: 每一次，反对吉姆·乔丹的人数都在增加。

sentences.en: The total number of votes cast is 432, of which the Honorable Jim Jordan of the state of Ohio has received 200 votes.
sentences.zh: 投票总数为432票，其中俄亥俄州的尊敬的吉姆·乔丹获得了200票。

sentences.en: On the first vote, there were 20 Republicans opposed to him.
sentences.zh: 在第一次投票中，有20名共和党人反对他。

sentences.en: No person having received a majority, the whole number of votes cast by surname, a speaker has not been elected.
sentences.zh: 无人获得多数票，按姓氏统计的投票总数显示，议长尚未选出。

sentences.en: By the second, as the calls kept coming in.
sentences.zh: 到了第二次，随着呼声不断传来。

sentences.en: Of placing in nomination the name of the Honorable Jim Jordan.
sentences.zh: 提名尊敬的吉姆·乔丹的名字。

sentences.en: It rose to 22 against him.
sentences.zh: 反对他的人数上升到了22人。

sentences.en: A speaker has not been elected.
sentences.zh: 议长尚未选出。

sentences.en: As more calls flooded in.
sentences.zh: 随着更多的呼声涌入。

sentences.en: I rise to nominate Jim Jordan for the speaker of the House.
sentences.zh: 我提名吉姆·乔丹为众议院议长。

sentences.en: The opposition rose to 25.
sentences.zh: 反对人数上升到了25人。

sentences.en: No person having received a majority, the whole number of votes cast by surname, a speaker has not been elected.
sentences.zh: 无人获得多数票，按姓氏统计的投票总数显示，议长尚未选出。

sentences.en: Fellow Republicans standing firm in opposition to Jim Jordan.
sentences.zh: 共和党同僚坚定地站在反对吉姆·乔丹的立场上。

sentences.en: One, the chair declares the House in recess, subject to the call of the chair.
sentences.zh: 第一，主席宣布众议院休会，听候主席召集。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: This was the revenge of the Republican moderates.
sentences.zh: 这是共和党温和派的复仇。

sentences.en: And it felt like a very distinct moment in time.
sentences.zh: 这感觉是一个非常独特的时刻。

sentences.en: And the lesson seemed to be, give us, give the Republicans in the House a much more mainstream candidate to be our speaker.
sentences.zh: 教训似乎是，给我们，给众议院的共和党人一个更主流的候选人来担任议长吧。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是这样。

sentences.en: You know, for years in Congress, the Republican Party has had something of a civil war.
sentences.zh: 你知道，多年来在国会，共和党内部一直存在某种内战。

sentences.en: But it was almost always the case that the hard right faction led by the House Freedom Caucus would use the tougher tactics.
sentences.zh: 但几乎总是由众议院自由核心小组领导的强硬右翼派系使用更强硬的手段。

sentences.en: And so they would get their way.
sentences.zh: 所以他们总是能如愿以偿。

sentences.en: And it was kind of a running joke on the Hill that the moderates always cave.
sentences.zh: 国会山上有一个流传的笑话，说温和派总是妥协。

sentences.en: That's the reason they're moderates, because they always want to compromise and make people happy.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们被称为温和派的原因，因为他们总是想妥协，让大家都高兴。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: There's even a nickname for these moderates.
sentences.zh: 这些温和派甚至有一个绰号。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: Some of the hard right members call them the squishes.
sentences.zh: 一些强硬右翼成员称他们为“软蛋”。

sentences.en: And for the first time that anyone can remember, the moderates stood up for themselves.
sentences.zh: 这是大家记忆中第一次，温和派站出来捍卫自己。

sentences.en: And they stood up in the face of this pressure campaign.
sentences.zh: 他们顶住了这场施压运动。

sentences.en: And they blocked Jim Jordan.
sentences.zh: 他们阻止了吉姆·乔丹。

sentences.en: And that sent a message.
sentences.zh: 这传递了一个信号。

sentences.en: I think a lot of us in the press corps believed that there would be a demand for a more mainstream or moderate candidate.
sentences.zh: 我想我们新闻界很多人都认为，人们会要求一位更主流或更温和的候选人。

sentences.en: And that led to the nomination of Tom Emmer of Minnesota on Tuesday afternoon,
sentences.zh: 这导致了周二下午明尼苏达州的汤姆·埃默获得提名，

sentences.en: who is the number three House Republican and perhaps the most moderate of all the potential candidates or leading candidates that have had a real chance at becoming speaker this year.
sentences.zh: 他是众议院共和党排名第三的人物，也许是今年所有潜在候选人或主要候选人中最温和的一位，且有真正机会成为议长。

sentences.en: And what makes him so moderate?
sentences.zh: 是什么让他如此温和？

sentences.en: Well, he has taken a number of votes that I don't think that seem that moderate to much of the country, but they do to the hard right.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他投过一些票，我认为在全国大部分地区看来并不那么温和，但在强硬右翼看来确实如此。

sentences.en: For instance, he voted to prevent discrimination against same-sex couples,
sentences.zh: 例如，他投票支持防止对同性伴侣的歧视，

sentences.en: and he refused to object to certifying President Biden's 2020 victory at a time when Donald Trump was putting intense pressure on House Republicans to overturn the election and keep him as the president.
sentences.zh: 而且在唐纳德·特朗普向众议院共和党人施加巨大压力要求推翻选举结果并让他留任总统时，他拒绝反对认证拜登总统2020年的胜利。

sentences.en: So, Emmer is kind of a moderate House Republicans' dream candidate for the speakership.
sentences.zh: 所以，埃默算是温和派众议院共和党人心目中理想的议长候选人。

sentences.en: But of course, we know that overall, House Republicans are not so moderate.
sentences.zh: 但当然，我们知道总体而言，众议院共和党人并不那么温和。

sentences.en: So how does Emmer contend with that?
sentences.zh: 那么埃默如何应对这一点呢？

sentences.en: So, Emmer is hopeful that he has the backing of the mainstream Republicans, but also has won enough friends on the hard right to make sure that he can become speaker.
sentences.zh: 所以，埃默希望得到主流共和党人的支持，同时也赢得了足够多的强硬右翼朋友，以确保他能成为议长。

sentences.en: But what becomes quickly apparent is that, although a majority of House Republicans support Tom Emmer, Donald Trump does not.
sentences.zh: 但很快显而易见的是，尽管大多数众议院共和党人支持汤姆·埃默，但唐纳德·特朗普不支持。

sentences.en: Donald Trump, the de facto leader of the Republican Party, who has a lot of influence in the House Republican conference, just put out a blistering statement attacking Tom Emmer.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普，共和党的事实领袖，在众议院共和党会议中拥有很大影响力，他刚刚发表了一份严厉的声明攻击汤姆·埃默。

sentences.en: Here's what Trump said.
sentences.zh: 这是特朗普所说的。

sentences.en: Voting for a globalist rhino like Tom Emmer would be a tragic mistake.
sentences.zh: 投票给像汤姆·埃默这样的全球主义共和党建制派将是一个悲剧性的错误。

sentences.en: And allies of Donald Trump go out on the airwaves and on their podcasts.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普的盟友们在广播和播客中纷纷发声。

sentences.en: I couldn't support Tom Emmer.
sentences.zh: 我无法支持汤姆·埃默。

sentences.en: We need a speaker of the House that reflects the values and the views of Republican voters across the country.
sentences.zh: 我们需要一位能够反映全国共和党选民价值观和观点的众议院议长。

sentences.en: And they support President Trump and they support his agenda.
sentences.zh: 他们支持特朗普总统，支持他的议程。

sentences.en: And Tom Emmer does not.
sentences.zh: 而汤姆·埃默不支持。

sentences.en: And start ripping him apart.
sentences.zh: 并开始对他进行猛烈抨击。

sentences.en: He certified the fake election.
sentences.zh: 他认证了那场虚假的选举。

sentences.en: He has been the wrong vote every single time.
sentences.zh: 他每一次投票都投错了。

sentences.en: He is Nancy Pelosi in a suit.
sentences.zh: 他就是穿着西装的南希·佩洛西。

sentences.en: They say he's not loyal to Trump.
sentences.zh: 他们说他对特朗普不忠诚。

sentences.en: And everyone who watches the War Room Posse in the show needs to fight Tom Emmer every step of the way.
sentences.zh: 每一个观看《作战室》节目的人都需要在每一步都与汤姆·埃默作斗争。

sentences.en: Emmer starts defending himself.
sentences.zh: 埃默开始为自己辩护。

sentences.en: He endorsed Donald Trump twice.
sentences.zh: 他曾两次支持唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: He has pictures of him with Donald Trump in his office.
sentences.zh: 他的办公室里有他和唐纳德·特朗普的照片。

sentences.en: He starts circulating those photos to media outlets to show how loyal he is to Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 他开始向媒体分发这些照片，以展示他对唐纳德·特朗普有多忠诚。

sentences.en: But it's still not enough for the hard right.
sentences.zh: 但这对于强硬右翼来说仍然不够。

sentences.en: So just four hours after he becomes the nominee, despite winning a majority of the votes,
sentences.zh: 所以就在他获得提名仅四个小时后，尽管赢得了多数选票，

sentences.en: there are still about two dozen hard right House Republicans standing in opposition to him, refusing to vote for Tom Emmer.
sentences.zh: 仍然有大约两打强硬右翼众议院共和党人站出来反对他，拒绝投票给汤姆·埃默。

sentences.en: And Tom Emmer sees no other way out of this than to resign and renounce his candidacy for speaker.
sentences.zh: 汤姆·埃默认为除了辞职并放弃议长候选人资格外别无他法。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So it turns out there are enough moderates to kill a Jordan candidacy, but not enough moderates to elect Tom Emmer.
sentences.zh: 所以事实证明，温和派足以扼杀乔丹的候选资格，但不足以选出汤姆·埃默。

sentences.en: That's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: And so Republicans are sent back to square one.
sentences.zh: 于是共和党人又回到了原点。

sentences.en: And they're kind of scraping the bottom of the barrel now to figure out who could be the speaker.
sentences.zh: 他们现在有点在矮子里拔将军，想弄清楚谁能当议长。

sentences.en: And so after Tom Emmer is deposed, six more Republicans throw their names in as potential candidates.
sentences.zh: 在汤姆·埃默被罢免后，又有六名共和党人投身成为潜在候选人。

sentences.en: Because basically everyone thinks, like, why not me?
sentences.zh: 因为基本上每个人都在想，为什么不是我呢？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, there's a joke that every senator looks in the mirror and sees a president.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，有个笑话是每个参议员照镜子时看到的都是总统。

sentences.en: And we're quickly learning that every member of the House, every male member of the House, I might say, looks in the mirror and sees a speaker.
sentences.zh: 我们很快了解到，每个众议院议员，我想说的是每个男性众议院议员，照镜子时看到的都是议长。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And so what happens to all these men looking in the mirror seeing a speaker?
sentences.zh: 那么所有这些照镜子看到议长的男人们会发生什么呢？

sentences.en: Well, six of them vie for the next round of votes.
sentences.zh: 嗯，其中六人参加了下一轮投票。

sentences.en: I guess this is the fifth time Republicans will try to nominate a speaker.
sentences.zh: 我想这是共和党人第五次尝试提名议长了。

sentences.en: And one name starts to rise above all the others.
sentences.zh: 有一个名字开始脱颖而出。

sentences.en: Democracy is messy sometimes, but it is our system.
sentences.zh: 民主有时是混乱的，但这就是我们的制度。

sentences.en: And that is someone who's far to the right of Tom Emmer, who has no problem with objecting to the 2020 election results.
sentences.zh: 而那个人在立场上比汤姆·埃默更偏右，他对于反对2020年选举结果没有任何问题。

sentences.en: This conference that you see, this House Republican majority is united.
sentences.zh: 你们所看到的这场会议，这个共和党多数派众议院是团结一致的。

sentences.en: And that is Mike Johnson of Louisiana.
sentences.zh: 他就是来自路易斯安那州的迈克·约翰逊。

sentences.en: This is servant leadership.
sentences.zh: 这就是仆人式领导。

sentences.en: We're going to serve the people of this country.
sentences.zh: 我们将为这个国家的人民服务。

sentences.en: We're going to restore their faith in this conference.
sentences.zh: 我们将恢复他们对这个会议的信心。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 430 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我在凌晨4点30分给总统打了电话，他接听了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 太空探索七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: 60 Super Sundays.
sentences.zh: 60个超级星期天。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联盟中最好的球队。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都用不同的起始词。

sentences.en: 25,000 recipes.
And I love a one pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢一锅出的食谱，因为我不喜欢洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: Celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 庆祝175年来，我们一直致力于帮助您了解世界，并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 立即订阅，享受 nytimes.com/subscribe 上的特别优惠。

sentences.en: So, Luke, tell us about this fourth nominee to be the Republican House Speaker who, I'm going to be really honest, I had never heard of before now.
sentences.zh: 那么，卢克，给我们介绍一下这位共和党众议院议长候选人吧，说实话，在此之前我从未听说过他。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And there's a good reason you haven't heard of him.
sentences.zh: 你没听说过他是有原因的。

sentences.en: He hasn't been in Congress that long.
sentences.zh: 他进入国会的时间还不长。

sentences.en: He's not the chairman of any major committee.
sentences.zh: 他不是任何主要委员会的主席。

sentences.en: He is, in fact, not the chairman of any committee.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他甚至不是任何委员会的主席。

sentences.en: And he's kind of a, you know, a little known member of Congress.
sentences.zh: 他算是一个，你知道的，不太出名的国会议员。

sentences.en: But here's what we do know about Mike Johnson.
sentences.zh: 但关于迈克·约翰逊，我们确实了解这些。

sentences.en: He is very conservative and he's also very religious.
sentences.zh: 他非常保守，而且也非常虔诚。

sentences.en: Welcome back to Truth Be Told.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回到《真相大白》。

sentences.en: I'm Mike Johnson.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克·约翰逊。

sentences.en: And I'm Kelly Johnson.
sentences.zh: 我是凯莉·约翰逊。

sentences.en: He hosts a podcast with his wife that's focused on Christianity.
sentences.zh: 他和妻子主持着一个专注于基督教的播客。

sentences.en: Today, we're going to provide an answer to the question that has been asked by countless hundreds of millions of people and probably by all of us at one point or another.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们将回答一个被数亿人问过，可能我们每个人在某个时候也都问过的问题。

sentences.en: How do I find God's will for my life?
sentences.zh: 我该如何找到上帝对我生命的旨意？

sentences.en: He often talks about being an evangelical Christian.
sentences.zh: 他经常谈论自己作为福音派基督徒的身份。

sentences.en: And those Christian views, those conservative Christian views, really do shape his politics.
sentences.zh: 而那些基督教观点，那些保守的基督教观点，确实塑造了他的政治立场。

sentences.en: Roe v.
sentences.zh: 罗诉韦德案。

sentences.en: Wade gave constitutional cover to the elective killing of unborn children in America, period.
sentences.zh: 为美国选择性地杀害未出生婴儿提供了宪法掩护，句号。

sentences.en: You think about the implications of that.
sentences.zh: 想想这其中的含义。

sentences.en: He's also very close with Jim Jordan.
sentences.zh: 他和吉姆·乔丹的关系也非常密切。

sentences.en: The two of them have traveled to Israel together to meet with Benjamin and Yahoo.
sentences.zh: 他们两人曾一起前往以色列，会见本雅明·内塔尼亚胡。

sentences.en: When you and Kelly went with Paulie and I to Israel a couple years ago, what a good time we had.
sentences.zh: 几年前你和凯莉跟我和保利一起去以色列时，我们玩得真开心。

sentences.en: It was.
sentences.zh: 确实是。

sentences.en: And a chance to learn about our great friend and ally, the state of Israel.
sentences.zh: 那是一个了解我们伟大的朋友和盟友——以色列国的机会。

sentences.en: Jim Jordan serves as a mentor to him and sort of helped him run for Congress originally and flew him out to meet with the House Freedom Caucus guys.
sentences.zh: 吉姆·乔丹是他的导师，最初在某种程度上帮助他竞选国会议员，并带他去见了众议院自由核心小组的人。

sentences.en: And just like Jim Jordan is very loyal to Donald Trump, so is Mike Johnson.
sentences.zh: 就像吉姆·乔丹对唐纳德·特朗普非常忠诚一样，迈克·约翰逊也是如此。

sentences.en: If Jim Jordan was the public face of fighting the 2020 election results in Congress, Mike Johnson was his silent partner.
sentences.zh: 如果说吉姆·乔丹是国会中反对2020年选举结果的公众形象，那么迈克·约翰逊就是他的幕后合伙人。

sentences.en: He was the constitutional lawyer behind the scenes coming up with various legal ways and theories that Congress could try to overturn the results of the election.
sentences.zh: 他是一位幕后的宪法律师，想出了各种法律途径和理论，试图让国会推翻选举结果。

sentences.en: The first thing he did was he tried to get members of Congress to sign on to an ultimately failed lawsuit to throw out Joe Biden's victory in four different states.
sentences.zh: 他做的第一件事就是试图让国会议员签署一份最终失败的诉讼，以推翻乔·拜登在四个州的胜利。

sentences.en: That lawsuit's rejected by the Supreme Court, but not before Mike Johnson gets 60 percent of House Republicans to sign on to it.
sentences.zh: 那起诉讼被最高法院驳回了，但在那之前，迈克·约翰逊已经让60%的共和党众议员签署了它。

sentences.en: And he does this by telling them he has spoken with President Trump and President Trump will be looking at the list of names and taking account of who supported him and who didn't.
sentences.zh: 他这样做是告诉他们，他已经与特朗普总统谈过，特朗普总统会查看名单，并记下谁支持了他，谁没有。

sentences.en: So Johnson seems even further to the right than Jim Jordan and thus, I would imagine, very unpalatable to those 20 or so moderates who had such problems with Jordan.
sentences.zh: 所以约翰逊看起来比吉姆·乔丹还要右倾，因此，我想，对于那些对乔丹有意见的20名左右温和派来说，他非常令人难以接受。

sentences.en: Yeah, a lot of us in the press corps thought when we heard his name that, you know, moderates would stand against him as they did against Jim Jordan.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们新闻界很多人听到他的名字时都认为，温和派会像反对吉姆·乔丹那样反对他。

sentences.en: But this time, that just didn't happen.
sentences.zh: 但这一次，这种情况并没有发生。

sentences.en: Well, why not?
sentences.zh: 嗯，为什么不呢？

sentences.en: Why would moderates not object to him?
sentences.zh: 为什么温和派不反对他？

sentences.en: Well, I think there's a couple reasons.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为有几个原因。

sentences.en: And some of the moderates we talked to in the hallways said, essentially,
sentences.zh: 我们在走廊里交谈过的一些温和派基本上说，

sentences.en: they were weighing the continued dysfunction of the House and the need to get back to business against how right-wing Johnson is.
sentences.zh: 他们正在权衡众议院持续的职能失调和恢复正常工作的必要性，与约翰逊的右翼程度之间的利弊。

sentences.en: So was it worse for them to have Mike Johnson as speaker and potentially support a right-wing candidate when they're from a district that's more of a swing district or a purple district?
sentences.zh: 那么，对于来自摇摆选区或中间选区的他们来说，让迈克·约翰逊担任议长并可能支持一位右翼候选人，情况会更糟吗？

sentences.en: Or was it worse to continue the three-ring circus taking place on Capitol Hill, head towards a government shutdown, deny funding for our allies overseas?
sentences.zh: 还是说，继续国会山上演的闹剧，走向政府停摆，拒绝为海外盟友提供资金，情况更糟？

sentences.en: So you can see how they looked at the situation and arrived at the result that it was better for them to vote for somebody just so they could get back to business.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以看出他们是如何看待这种情况，并得出结论：为了恢复工作，投票给某个人对他们来说更好。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: You're saying these moderates start to worry less about picking the wrong speaker and the political repercussions of that than they do about picking no speaker and being associated with a deeply dysfunctional Congress because voters don't like that either.
sentences.zh: 你是说这些温和派开始减少担心选错议长及其带来的政治后果，转而担心选不出议长，并被贴上职能严重失调的国会的标签，因为选民也不喜欢那样。

sentences.en: That's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: And one thing that differentiates Johnson from Jordan is that he doesn't have the baggage in some members' views as Jordan did.
sentences.zh: 而且约翰逊与乔丹的一个区别在于，在一些议员看来，他没有乔丹那样的包袱。

sentences.en: You've got to remember, Jim Jordan came to Congress and was described by a previous Republican speaker as a legislative terroriSt.
sentences.zh: 你必须记住，吉姆·乔丹进入国会时，被前任共和党议长描述为“立法恐怖分子”。

sentences.en: And he had blown up a bunch of bills to fund the government and sort of the basic bills of keeping the place open.
sentences.zh: 他曾炸毁了一堆为政府提供资金的法案，以及维持机构运转的基本法案。

sentences.en: And so there were long memories about Jordan's misdeeds in their mind.
sentences.zh: 所以，人们对乔丹的恶行记忆犹新。

sentences.en: And Johnson just doesn't have the bad blood with his fellow Republicans that Jordan does.
sentences.zh: 而约翰逊与他的共和党同僚之间并没有像乔丹那样的积怨。

sentences.en: And so that combined with the fact that there's a lot of fatigue on the Hill.
sentences.zh: 再加上国会山普遍存在的疲劳感。

sentences.en: People are sick of not having a speaker.
sentences.zh: 人们厌倦了没有议长的日子。

sentences.en: They're sick of going home on the weekend and having their constituents yell at them because they're so dysfunctional.
sentences.zh: 他们厌倦了周末回家时被选民斥责，因为他们表现得如此无能。

sentences.en: And all of that built up to really a glide path for Mike Johnson, a guy who would have had probably no chance of becoming speaker a month ago,
sentences.zh: 所有这些积累起来，为迈克·约翰逊铺平了道路，一个一个月前可能根本没有机会成为议长的人，

sentences.en: to having the unanimous support of his conference.
sentences.zh: 最终获得了他所在会议的一致支持。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So I want to just review the journey that we have been on.
sentences.zh: 所以我想回顾一下我们所经历的旅程。

sentences.en: One, Kevin McCarthy is ousted as speaker by these far-right members of the House, just eight of them.
sentences.zh: 第一，凯文·麦卡锡被这些极右翼的众议院成员罢免了议长职务，仅仅八个人。

sentences.en: The first nominee to replace him ends up being rejected as insufficiently conservative.
sentences.zh: 取代他的第一位候选人最终因保守程度不足而被拒绝。

sentences.en: The second nominee is knocked out not because he's not conservative enough, Jim Jordan was, but because he's personally kind of hated.
sentences.zh: 第二位候选人被淘汰不是因为他不够保守——吉姆·乔丹很保守——而是因为他个人有点招人恨。

sentences.en: The third nominee fails because he's not conservative enough, Tom Emmer.
sentences.zh: 第三位候选人汤姆·埃默失败是因为他不够保守。

sentences.en: And ultimately, the winner is a very, very conservative member, Mike Johnson.
sentences.zh: 最终，获胜者是一位非常、非常保守的成员，迈克·约翰逊。

sentences.en: So there's not a lot of mystery about, ideologically speaking, who won here.
sentences.zh: 所以，从意识形态上讲，谁赢了这里，并没有什么悬念。

sentences.en: House conservatives won.
sentences.zh: 众议院保守派赢了。

sentences.en: So how should we think about why this was such an ugly 21-day war among people who largely seem like they're on the same page?
sentences.zh: 那么，我们该如何看待为什么这场21天的战争在看起来志同道合的人之间会如此丑陋？

sentences.en: In many ways, this is really the first sort of MAGA-controlled House.
sentences.zh: 在许多方面，这确实是第一个由“让美国再次伟大”（MAGA）控制的众议院。

sentences.en: Before this, we had Democrats in charge of the House, or we had Republican speakers who were more in line with the old Republican Party, right?
sentences.zh: 在此之前，民主党控制着众议院，或者我们有更符合旧共和党路线的共和党议长，对吧？

sentences.en: The more business-minded wing of the party who cared about small budgets and aggressive military.
sentences.zh: 那是党内更具商业头脑的派系，关心小预算和强硬的军事政策。

sentences.en: Now it's a much more populist party that's remade in Donald Trump's image.
sentences.zh: 现在这是一个更民粹主义的政党，按照唐纳德·特朗普的形象重塑了。

sentences.en: It's people, for the most part, who don't like the status quo, who want to tear down the establishment, who want to blow things up.
sentences.zh: 这些人大多不喜欢现状，想要推翻建制，想要搞破坏。

sentences.en: And so when you have a ton of people like that in the same room, it's essentially a wrecking ball that's flying around all the time.
sentences.zh: 所以当你在同一个房间里有大量这样的人时，它本质上就是一个一直在四处飞舞的破坏球。

sentences.en: And it's unclear who's going to be hit at any given time.
sentences.zh: 而且不清楚任何时候谁会被击中。

sentences.en: And so we saw, over the course of this first year of this Congress, an unprecedented five different speaker nominees.
sentences.zh: 所以我们看到，在这一届国会的第一年里，出现了前所未有的五位不同的议长候选人。

sentences.en: And then what did they get out of the fifth nominee?
sentences.zh: 那么他们从第五位候选人那里得到了什么？

sentences.en: The most conservative, the most hard right, the guy who literally did Donald Trump's bidding in trying to overturn the election,
sentences.zh: 最保守、最强硬的右翼，那个在试图推翻选举结果时真正听命于唐纳德·特朗普的人，

sentences.en: who actually served as one of his lawyers at one point in time and as an advisor.
sentences.zh: 他实际上曾一度担任他的律师和顾问。

sentences.en: And in fact, Matt Gaetz, who is the member of Congress who got Kevin McCarthy kicked out as Speaker, goes on Steve Bannon's podcast, Steve Bannon, a Trump ally.
sentences.zh: 事实上，罢免凯文·麦卡锡议长职务的国会议员马特·盖茨，上了史蒂夫·班农的播客，史蒂夫·班农是特朗普的盟友。

sentences.en: It is going to be a great moment for the House.
sentences.zh: 这对众议院来说将是一个伟大的时刻。

sentences.en: And you know what?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？

sentences.en: At the very end...
sentences.zh: 在最后……

sentences.en: And boasts that they have had an upgrade at Speaker.
sentences.zh: 并吹嘘他们换了一位更好的议长。

sentences.en: And the swamp is on the run.
sentences.zh: 沼泽地正在逃窜。

sentences.en: MAGA is ascendant.
sentences.zh: MAGA正在崛起。

sentences.en: And if you don't think that moving from Kevin McCarthy to MAGA Mike Johnson shows the ascendance of this movement and where the power in the Republican Party truly lies,
sentences.zh: 如果你不认为从凯文·麦卡锡换成“MAGA迈克”·约翰逊显示了这场运动的崛起以及共和党内权力的真正归属，

sentences.en: then you're not paying attention.
sentences.zh: 那你就是没在关注。

sentences.en: But they are...
sentences.zh: 但他们……

sentences.en: They've got a more MAGA member who is now leading the United States House of Representatives.
sentences.zh: 他们现在有一位更MAGA的成员在领导美国众议院。

sentences.en: But Luke, this outcome, it feels like potentially a momentary pause in that ever-swinging wrecking ball within MAGA House Republican politics.
sentences.zh: 但是卢克，这个结果感觉像是MAGA共和党众议院政治中那个不断摆动的破坏球的暂时停顿。

sentences.en: And that pause, where everyone can get on the same page before they begin wrecking each other again, it might be a few months, it might be a few days, it might be a few hours.
sentences.zh: 而那个停顿，在他们再次开始互相破坏之前，每个人都能达成一致，可能是几个月，可能是几天，也可能是几个小时。

sentences.en: We don't really know.
sentences.zh: 我们真的不知道。

sentences.en: And so, how should we think about Mike Johnson's chances of being a successful speaker?
sentences.zh: 那么，我们该如何看待迈克·约翰逊成为一名成功议长的机会？

sentences.en: Because 21 days ago, the first chapter of this began, a speaker was ousted.
sentences.zh: 因为21天前，这一切的第一章开始了，一位议长被罢免了。

sentences.en: That could happen all over again, given everything you just said.
sentences.zh: 考虑到你刚才所说的一切，这一切完全可能再次发生。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Well, Mike Johnson has been able to do something that no other speaker or candidate could do.
sentences.zh: 嗯，迈克·约翰逊能够做到其他议长或候选人都做不到的事情。

sentences.en: He was able to unite House Republicans in a way no one else has.
sentences.zh: 他以一种无人能及的方式团结了共和党众议员。

sentences.en: He looks like he has the command of the party.
sentences.zh: 他看起来确实掌控了党派。

sentences.en: But that said, this is a particularly unruly Congress.
sentences.zh: 但话虽如此，这是一个特别难以管束的国会。

sentences.en: Mike Johnson will probably have a grace period for some period of time.
sentences.zh: 迈克·约翰逊可能会有一段宽限期。

sentences.en: But eventually, he's going to have to make some decisions about keeping the government open, about the debt.
sentences.zh: 但最终，他将不得不就保持政府开放、债务问题做出一些决定。

sentences.en: And it's hard not to see a scenario where some of the same complaints and concerns that the hard right had with Kevin McCarthy might come back to Mike Johnson.
sentences.zh: 很难想象极右翼对凯文·麦卡锡的那些抱怨和担忧不会在迈克·约翰逊身上重演。

sentences.en: Keep in mind, the same rule that hard right Republicans use to oust McCarthy is still in effect in the Congress.
sentences.zh: 请记住，极右翼共和党人用来罢免麦卡锡的同一条规则在国会中仍然有效。

sentences.en: So, at any point, a member can call, can force a vote to remove a speaker.
sentences.zh: 所以，在任何时候，议员都可以要求、可以强行投票罢免议长。

sentences.en: This Congress has been one that ends up eating its own.
sentences.zh: 这一届国会最终会自相残杀。

sentences.en: And so, the test for Mike Johnson will be, how long can he hold off until they eat him too?
sentences.zh: 所以，对迈克·约翰逊的考验将是，他能坚持多久，直到他们也吃掉他？

sentences.en: Well, Luke.
sentences.zh: 好吧，卢克。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们很感激。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: And this group will deliver for the American people.
sentences.zh: 这个团队将为美国人民交付成果。

sentences.en: I said it in the chamber, and I will say it here.
sentences.zh: 我在议事厅里说过，我也会在这里说。

sentences.en: We're going to govern well.
sentences.zh: 我们将治理得很好。

sentences.en: On Wednesday afternoon, about an hour after his election, Speaker Johnson held a brief news conference on the steps of the Capitol.
sentences.zh: 周三下午，在他当选约一小时后，约翰逊议长在国会大厦台阶上举行了简短的新闻发布会。

sentences.en: We're so grateful, I'm so grateful, and so humbled to have gotten a unanimous vote on the floor by all of my colleagues here.
sentences.zh: 我们非常感激，我非常感激，也非常谦卑地获得了这里所有同事在议会大厅的一致投票。

sentences.en: Johnson said he would dispense with the usual ceremonies and celebrations of a new speaker and immediately get to work.
sentences.zh: 约翰逊表示，他将免去新议长通常的仪式和庆祝活动，立即投入工作。

sentences.en: We went through a lot to get here, but we are ready to govern.
sentences.zh: 我们经历了很多才走到这一步，但我们已经准备好治理国家了。

sentences.en: And that will begin right away.
sentences.zh: 这将立即开始。

sentences.en: You've all heard me talk a lot today, and I'm not going to belabor the point because the sun is bright and it's too warm for the fall.
sentences.zh: 你们今天都听我说了不少，我不会再啰嗦了，因为阳光很明媚，秋天来说太暖和了。

sentences.en: But I'll say this.
sentences.zh: 但我会说这一点。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是温纳卢。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times Games, and I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我编写了《Connections》游戏，这是《纽约时报》游戏中的谜题之一，我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog, and I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗，也喜欢尝试捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基，我每天创作《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做“联觉”的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我在听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像你们刚才听到的人那样的人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 前往 nytimes.com/games 立即开始游戏。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是您今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: At least seven people were killed and many more injured in a mass shooting in the town of Lewiston, Maine, where a gunman reportedly opened fire at a restaurant and bowling alley.
sentences.zh: 缅因州刘易斯顿市发生大规模枪击事件，造成至少七人死亡，多人受伤。据报道，一名枪手在当地一家餐厅和保龄球馆开火。

sentences.en: As of Thursday morning, a massive manhunt was underway to capture the shooter, who was caught on camera using what appeared to be an assault rifle.
sentences.zh: 截至周四上午，一场大规模搜捕行动正在进行，旨在抓捕这名枪手。监控摄像头拍到他使用了疑似突击步枪的武器。

sentences.en: Lewiston, Maine's second biggest city, is about 40 miles north of Portland and home to Bates College, where students were told to shelter in place.
sentences.zh: 刘易斯顿是缅因州第二大城市，位于波特兰以北约40英里处，也是贝茨学院的所在地，该校学生已被告知就地避难。

sentences.en: And on Wednesday, with little warning, Hurricane Otis made landfall near the Mexican resort town of Acapulco as a catastrophic Category 5 hurricane.
sentences.zh: 周三，飓风“奥蒂斯”在几乎毫无预警的情况下，以五级飓风的灾难性强度在墨西哥度假胜地阿卡普尔科附近登陆。

sentences.en: Unlike most storms that intensify slowly and are tracked closely by meteorologists, Otis gained strength with stunning speed,
sentences.zh: 与大多数缓慢增强并受到气象学家密切追踪的风暴不同，“奥蒂斯”以惊人的速度增强，

sentences.en: its winds growing by 110 miles per hour in just 24 hours.
sentences.zh: 其风速在短短24小时内增加了每小时110英里。

sentences.en: In interviews and social media posts, residents and tourists described widespread damage from the storm.
sentences.zh: 在接受采访和发布在社交媒体上的内容中，当地居民和游客描述了风暴造成的广泛破坏。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Michael Simon-Johnson and Rochelle Bongia.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由迈克尔·西蒙-约翰逊和罗谢尔·邦吉亚制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by Rachel Quester and Lexi Diao.
sentences.zh: 由雷切尔·奎斯特和莱克西·迪奥编辑。

sentences.en: Contains original music by Brad Fisher, Dan Powell, and Marion Lozano.
sentences.zh: 包含布拉德·费舍尔、丹·鲍威尔和马里昂·洛萨诺的原创音乐。

sentences.en: And was engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 由克里斯·伍德负责工程制作。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Landsberg of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由Wonderly的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰兹伯格创作。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Balboro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴尔伯罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》节目，我们将为您准备假日待客之道。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 敬请收听，了解如何让您的客人在家中感到宾至如归。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是那种需要全黑环境才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我指的不是他们是否喝到断片才去睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们对光线有什么要求？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这可是非常具体的需求。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物不耐受吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 您可以在《纽约时报》应用程序或您喜欢的任何播客平台上收听《Wirecutter秀》。
